sections.heading: Advent Calendar Cabinet with Doors FAQ
sections.text: Questions Advent Calendar Cabinet with Doors FAQ What is the difference between this and a drawer-only calendar? This cabinet has two doors in front of the drawers, so it looks like one closed gift box until it is opened. A drawer-only calendar shows the numbered drawers straight away and is simpler to make. How are the doors kept closed? With a satin ribbon tied across the doors, or with magnets hidden under the wrap. How many drawers can it have? Common formats are 12, 24 or 25 drawers. The count and drawer sizes are set by your products and confirmed after structure review. When should I order for Christmas? Start early: the structure and a physical sample are approved before bulk production, and freight time comes on top. Overseas Christmas orders are usually placed in early summer; we confirm the schedule on the quote.
